title: Aftermath and Blue Hour
author: Jude Vasquez
blurb: Ines Delacroix, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
